text: {"lessons":["A short run of gains and losses does not predict what comes next, so I should not trade based on recent price direction.","Selling some shares after gains and buying others can help rebalance, but I should base decisions on risk and diversification rather than being anchored to average cost or past gains.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should use a consistent plan and avoid impulsive trades while keeping enough cash to respect my no-borrowing constraint."]}
